About Me

Security-minded builder, analyst, and lab tinkerer.

I’m Jack Diamond, a cybersecurity learner focused on SOC operations, detection engineering, and practical security research through hands-on lab work.

Who I am

I like solving security problems with a mix of curiosity, structure, and real-world practice. My work blends alert investigation, log analysis, home lab experimentation, and a growing understanding of how modern security teams detect, respond to, and prevent threats.

The goal is simple: build repeatable workflows, understand the why behind detections, and keep learning in a way that feels practical, hands-on, and relevant to real defensive operations.

Current focus

  • • SOC operations and alert triage
  • • SIEM and telemetry investigation
  • • Detection engineering and tuning
  • • Home lab security tooling and validation

Certifications
